turns.text: Hi, I'm Owen's teacher. Thanks for coming in.
Why was a zero entered on Owen's essay before anyone called me?
Thanks for coming in, Ms. Kalinowski. I know your schedule is brutal.
Flattery won't help Owen. Answer my question: who decided on the zero, and before or after anyone spoke to him?
I have to say, you're far more reasonable than I expected. Most parents come in swinging.
I'm not here to be reasonable, Hale. I'm here about Owen's essay. Who decided on the zero, and when?
It's refreshing. You clearly see the whole picture, so I think we're really on the same side here.
We're not on the same side. Who decided on the zero, and what do you have besides the checker?
